_note: 2026-10-19: aligned to the live blue_dot job_posting_1.0 schema (bluedots-schemas up-gzb/network.json). hiringManagerPhoneNumber is REQUIRED to go live: without it every DKB post stayed a hidden draft. Verified on gzb with a test post (live, then retired). 2026-10-19 (later): hiringManagerPhoneNumber now comes from a hiringManagerPhone parameter (the dialled number by default, or another number the owner gives), per Aryan.
name: update_job
description: Update an existing Signals job posting by its item_id (job_id). Persists only Signals-allowed item_state fields. Writing about posting does not post: if you told the owner you are posting or updating the job you MUST invoke this tool in that same turn, and never say it is posted until this tool returns a result. Never emit a stage direction such as "(calling create_job)" into your reply — the owner hears it and nothing was posted.

role.description: updated job role. English / Latin letters only.

title.description: updated job title. English / Latin letters only.

job_id.description: the Signals job_posting item_id to update (a real UUID; never 'Not Available'). Exactly the item_id from get_employer or create_job, nothing added before or after it (no comma, no space).

positions.description: updated number of vacancies, as a string Send as a NUMBER, not a string.

companyName.description: employer/company name (top-level name). In English / Latin letters only, never Devanagari or Kannada script: "ट्यूनर मोबाइल शॉप" is "Tuner Mobile Shop" (8178a26e posted it in Devanagari).

natureOfJob.description: Nature of the job, one of these values only. Part-time or shift work -> Flexible. Default Full-time.

phoneNumber.description: The caller's ten digits (the last ten digits of their number), no +91. Always send it: without it the job board rejects the update (a3f61db8).

jobProviderLocation.description: updated work location, in English. English / Latin letters only.

hiringManagerName.description: The name of the person you are speaking to, in Latin script; send it so the post can stay live.

salaryMin.description: Monthly salary in rupees, lower end, as a NUMBER (12000). A single figure: send it as both salaryMin and salaryMax. Omit if the owner gave no salary.

salaryMax.description: Monthly salary in rupees, upper end, as a NUMBER. Same as salaryMin for a single figure. Omit if none given.

minEducationalInstitute.description: Minimum education the owner asked for, mapped to one value: 10th/12th/school -> School; graduate/BA/BCom -> College; ITI -> ITI; polytechnic/diploma -> Diploma; no requirement -> None. Omit if not discussed.

candidateExperienceType.description: Whether the owner wants freshers, experienced people, or has no preference. Omit if not discussed.

workExperienceYears.description: Years of experience the owner asked for, only when they named a number. Omit otherwise.

workingHours.description: Working hours as the owner said them, in English, e.g. '9 AM to 6 PM'. Omit if not discussed.

benefitsOffered.description: Benefits the owner named, as a JSON array of these values only. Omit if none.

hiringManagerPhone.description: The 10-digit number candidates should call, digits only, no +91. REQUIRED by the job board for the post to go live. Use the caller's ten digits unchanged when the owner said yes to "क्या कैंडिडेट इसी नंबर पर आपसे बात कर सकते हैं?"; only when they gave a different number, send that number (exactly the ten digits they said, confirmed back once).
